kill_condition: Keep iff, on the large target: (a) C beats R on recall by >= 10 pts AND by more than the within-arm run spread; (b) the gate suite yields >= K=1 killable gap missed by all finders, confirmed killable after triage; (c) P beats C on precision by >= 8 pts AND by more than the within-arm run spread. Kill iff C is within R's run spread AND the gates yield near-zero killable-missed gaps after triage. A negative high-severity delta is expected and is not a kill trigger. K=1 is the floor read as 'keep exploring'; >= 5 confirmed killable-missed gaps is a clear signal. Authoritative text: plan.md.
notes: budget_per_arm is set from the calibration read (one arm P over ~1-2k lines, meter before/after), not a token count. Prompt hashes are sha256 of the frozen files at pin time.
